story.title: Tom Lee’s Ethereum Year-End Call Is Now Half Of What He Called ‘Conservative’ Last Month, But He Expects ‘Monster Moves’ In The Crypto Industry - Yahoo Finance

facts.text: Ethereum (ETH) held above $2,400 on Saturday after BitMine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) chairman Tom Lee said the token should top $5,000 by year-end, half the level he called a "conservative target" more than a week ago.
Investors "aren't bullish enough," he said, and should expect "some monster moves in crypto prices."
To support his point, Lee said, "Think Arthur's conservative in the sense that you know in the past cycles Ethereum has gone up 50 times to 200 times."
Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.
On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around Ethereum remained in the 'bearish' zone, with chatter at 'normal' levels over the last day.

BitMine Immersion Technologies chairman Tom Lee said Ethereum should top $5,000 by year-end, in Singapore on Friday.That was half the $10,000 year-end figure Lee called "conservative" when he also said Ethereum would trade "much higher" than that level within 12 months.His cycle target came down too, to "25,000 or 50,000 per token" from an illustrative $62,000 nine days earlier.Ethereum (ETH) held above $2,400 on Saturday after BitMine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) chairman Tom Lee said the token should top $5,000 by year-end, half the level he called a “conservative target” more than a week ago.Speaking at Token 2049 in Singapore on Friday, Lee, who is also co-founder and head of research at Fundstrat, tied the call to Bitcoin (BTC).

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around Ethereum remained in the ‘bearish’ zone, with chatter at ‘normal’ levels over the last day.Why This Cycle Is DifferentLee argued this cycle will outrun past ones because of who was buying.

Investors “aren’t bullish enough,” he said, and should expect “some monster moves in crypto prices.”Why BitMine Bets On EthereumLee pointed to Ethereum’s developer base and its record without downtime.
